description.value:
Due to the strange nature of this feature it is possible for 2 people to be instructed on how to use this feature and then have a Training Arc with a Partner together to fully learn the feature together for the cost of 2 Training Boons each.

Alternatively, you may have a Training Arc with a Partner together with someone that knows the Fusion Dance and gain advantage on Fusion Dances with that person for 2 Training Boons each.
